description: A full-length dark brown open robe with broad gold geometric woven-looking borders along both front edges, cuffs and lower hem. A cream long-sleeved full-length tunic underneath has a short open collar and restrained tan-gold neck and cuff decoration. A wide ochre-brown patterned sash secures the waist, with one long fringed end hanging down the front. The opaque layered fabrics have a matte textured surface; exact fibres are uncertain. Dark brown boots are visible beneath the garments. No headgear, armor or weapons appear.
